_about: Calvin texts missing from lane A's calvin_shelf.json, which holds the Calvin Translation Society set (commentaries via fetch_sources.py, Beveridge's Institutes, Tracts, Letters) and lists John Allen's Institutes as 'pending, not searched'. Kept as a separate shelf (the chesterton-gaps precedent) so lane A's file is never edited. Allen's translation (London, 1813) is held in the first American edition 'from the London edition' (Philadelphia: Philip H. Nicklin, 1816, 3 vols), the only complete set of the three-volume form found; the London 1813 vols 2-3 are alternates. Calvin's Calvinism (Henry Cole's translation of De aeterna praedestinatione and De occulta providentia, London 1856-57) is held in the 1927 Sovereign Grace Union reprint, the only scan found with both parts. Internet Archive OCR, raw and unconverted; each title page read before listing.
